Measure the wait between jobs

By v/hNovember 22, 2026Visual note

Originally shared
on LinkedIn

View the post ↗← All journal entries

A device that finishes quickly can still make the next job wait.

Imagine a utility that handles one item well, then needs a cooling pause before it can handle another. A demonstration with a single item would leave out the wait that matters when several need attention together.

We would test a run of tasks at the pace people need them. Record the quality of each result and the time until the device is ready again. Any cooling, reset or refill time belongs in the comparison with the current routine.

For v/h, the local model and the mechanism must fit the same pattern of use. The device should check its readiness and make a required wait clear through its own controls and feedback.

Our first utility is in development. The example and diagram describe a proposed development check, not measured performance.
